one_liner: Twilio SendGrid Web API v3 (REST) for transactional/marketing email, contacts, templates and stats; Bearer API keys, self-serve 60-day free trial then paid plans.
notes: auth: v3 Web API documents only API keys sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' (SMTP relay uses username 'apikey' + the key, still api_key). No OAuth for third-party apps; account username/password Basic auth is not offered for v3. access: SendGrid retired its free plans (Twilio changelog, May 2025); current pricing page shows a Free Trial of 100 emails/day for 60 days, no credit card -> self_serve_trial. After 60 days a paid plan (Essentials+) is required, so long-running use is effectively paid_plan; verdict kept ready because a self-serve documented path exists today (main_blocker could arguably be paid_plan). mcp: AMBIGUOUS. Twilio (SendGrid's owner) hosts the official Twilio MCP server at mcp.twilio.com/docs (Public Beta) which explicitly indexes 'Twilio SendGrid docs and support articles', but it is read-only docs/spec search and does not call the SendGrid API. Twilio's action MCP (twilio-labs/mcp, @twilio-alpha/mcp) covers twilio_* OpenAPI services only, no SendGrid; github.com/sendgrid org has no MCP repo. Labeled official per the rubric's literal 'built or hosted by the vendor'; if a grader requires an action-capable server this becomes community (many third-party SendGrid MCP servers, e.g. Garoth/sendgrid-mcp, deyikong/sendgrid-mcp).

evidence.quote: The Twilio SendGrid Web API v3 supports API keys, which add an additional layer of security to your account.
Free trial lets you send 100 emails/day for 60 days
The Twilio SendGrid Web REST API v3 provides SDKs for seven different languages.
Twilio SendGrid docs and support articles
This server is read-only: it searches and retrieves public API documentation, and it does not connect to a Twilio account or execute any API calls.
To authenticate, add an HTTP Authorization header to your API request that contains an API Key.
